title: EEG-Jev: A Unified Single-Pass Decision Model for EEG
abstract: arXiv:2611.31875v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: EEG analysis spans choosing alternatives, judging statements, and rating ordered attributes, requiring calibratable probabilities with explicit meaning. We present EEG-Jev, a unified single-pass decision model for EEG. Given an EEG window, a question and an answer specification, one forward pass returns a typed readout: CHOICE gives a candidate distribution, NOUL a proposition probability, and SCORE an ordered-level distribution and expectation. One checkpoint is trained jointly and evaluated once on held-out splits of 35 public sources. Core raw outputs reach 54.08% balanced accuracy on Stieger2021 motor imagery, 70.45% on Sleep-EDF-SC sleep staging, 72.11% per window at threshold 0.5 on CHB-MIT seizure detection with 0.825 AUROC, and 1.700 MAE on 0-10 ds005292 pain ratings. Prior correction and temperature scaling lower negative log-likelihood from 0.766 to 0.606 on Sleep-EDF-SC and 0.166 to 0.019 on CHB-MIT, while direct readout cut

translated_title: EEG-Jev：一种面向脑电（EEG）的统一单次前向决策模型
translated_abstract: 脑电（EEG）分析涵盖从备选项中选择、对陈述进行判断以及对有序属性进行评分等任务，需要具有明确含义且可校准的概率。我们提出EEG-Jev，一种统一的脑电单次前向决策模型。给定一个脑电窗口、一个问题及答案规范，仅需一次前向传播即可返回类型化的输出：CHOICE给出候选选项分布，NOUL给出命题概率，SCORE给出有序等级分布及期望值。该模型仅训练一个联合检查点，并在35个公开数据源的保留划分上一次性评估。核心原始输出在Stieger2021运动想象任务上达到54.08%的平衡准确率，在Sleep-EDF-SC睡眠分期上达到70.45%，在CHB-MIT癫痫检测上以阈值0.5达到每窗口72.11%的准确率（AUROC为0.825），在0–10分的ds005292疼痛评分上MAE为1.700。先验校正与温度缩放将Sleep-EDF-SC上的负对数似然从0.766降至0.606，在CHB-MIT上从0.166降至0.019，同时直接输出削减……
tldr: EEG-Jev提出了一种统一的脑电单次前向决策模型，一次前向传播即可完成选项选择、命题判断与有序评分三类任务，并通过先验校正和温度缩放提供含义明确、可校准的概率输出，在多个公开脑电数据集上取得了优异表现。
en_tdlr: EEG-Jev presents a unified single-pass decision model for EEG that handles choice, proposition judgment, and ordered rating tasks in one forward pass, delivering calibratable probabilities with explicit meaning via prior correction and temperature scaling, achieving strong performance across multiple public EEG datasets.
